description:
Change of use from coffee shop into Proposed Pasta - Grill - Restaurant and front patio. The existing coffee shop, art workshop and storage room will be demolishing and rebuilding proposed restaurant. The proposed pasta - grill - restaurant will be the same size as existing coffee shop, art workshop and storage room in length and width we will also match the hight which will be slightly over the existing boundary brickwall. 

The proposed pasta - grill - restaurant construction, the rear and side elevation is brickwall to match existing boundary wall and main building Mosque, front elevation is folding sliding doors and right part of the front elevation is brick wall (please see proposed floor plan and elevations for further details).

The proposed restaurant is part of Mosque to serve local community, the restaurant will be non-alcohol use, therefore the disturbance to the neighbouring’s properties in nearby area will be minimum. 

We proposed new non-smoking charcoal grill; the new non-smoking charcoal grill will not produce any smoke to the neighbouring properties.
